additional_info.subject: ID0415658-DC/Si-D/DE-[170003980]  CCV QR Code not working CRM:02698000012
additional_info.body:
Hello Anna,
I was able to reach out to Mr. Frenger via phone, so we didn't use the Teams meeting but thank you very much for setting up that meeting fast.
After our tests today, we were able to understand the root cause, since this seems like a software issue I will bring this to the R&D and get an answer.
Results of the tests today were:
First test
We tried to authenticate via Credit Card terminal and it was stuck waiting for their server - possible CCV issue
Second test (after a reboot)
We could reach the QR code and able to request the Receipt number but “Receipt not found" , I see in the logs a message that says that the receipt could not be generated. But the amount requested from CCV is incorrect.
Third test in the 2nd charger 170003981
Same as above but the amount requested is 100% ok.
As soon as I have an update on this topic I will be sure to reply to you again.
Thanks a lot for your time and availability, and have a nice day.
Best regards,
Francisco
